items.q: Is the 2027 board exam date sheet out?
items.label: Not out yet
items.detail: CBSE has not published the Class 10 and 12 date sheet for 2027. Ignore date sheets forwarded on WhatsApp. Last year the final one came on 30 October.

items.q: Are the 2027 practical exam dates announced?
items.label: Expected soon
items.detail: There is no 2027 practical circular yet. In 2026, regular schools held practicals from 1 January to 14 February, and winter-bound schools go earlier. Your school gives you your date.

items.q: Will Class 10 have two board exams in 2027?
items.label: Expected, dates awaited
items.detail: News reports expect two phases again, February to March and May 2027, but CBSE has not confirmed the 2027 dates. They will come with the date sheet.

items.label: Out
items.detail: CBSE has released sample papers with marking schemes for Class 10 and 12. You will find them on the Papers page.

items.q: Has the exam pattern changed for 2026-27?
items.label: Unchanged
items.detail: CBSE says the question paper design and assessment pattern are the same as last year, and the passing criteria are unchanged.

items.q: Has the deadline for the school's candidate list (LOC) passed?
items.label: Late window
items.detail: Your school submits this, not you. The regular deadline was 21 October, and news reports say late submission with a fee is accepted until 30 October. Ask your school to confirm your name is on it.

items.q: Does CBSE hold a board exam for your class?
items.label: No, your school does
items.detail: CBSE sets board exams only for Class 10 and 12. Your annual exam dates come from your school.

items.label: Out
items.detail: The official CBSE syllabus for 2026-27 is on the Syllabus page, one PDF per subject.

items.q: Is there a question bank to practise from?
items.label: Available
items.detail: Practice questions and NCERT Exemplar problems are on the Question bank page.
